description: An `async def` with `yield` (PEP 525): it can `await` between items and produces them only when the consumer asks.
Awaits `__anext__()` for each item until `StopAsyncIteration`; also usable in comprehensions (`[x async for x in gen]`).
Throws `GeneratorExit` into a suspended async generator so its `finally` blocks run; `break` alone does not call it.
An async context manager (3.10) that awaits `aclose()` on exit, for deterministic cleanup of async generators.
The async context manager protocol; a truthy return value from `__aexit__` suppresses the block's exception.
